title: How busy are the GPUs?
story: Geiss-01 has 8 GPUs that everyone in the course shares. Check how many are free right now.

tasks.text: Report how many GPUs are free

hints: `nvidia-smi` shows every GPU and how much of it is in use. A free GPU uses 0MiB and 0%.
Run `nvidia-smi` and count the GPUs that show 0MiB of memory in use.
Run `nvidia-smi`, count the rows with 0MiB / 97887MiB, then type that number in the answer box.
